title: Retrospective Progress-Aware Self-Refinement for LLM Agent Training
title_zh: 面向 LLM Agent 训练的回顾式进展感知自我优化
abstract_en: LLM-based agents trained with reinforcement learning optimize step-wise action prediction but lack metacognitive awareness of task progress, inducing a gap that hinders long-horizon scaling. A pilot study reveals that online progress prompting hurts performance while retrospective demonstrations help, yet this capability cannot emerge from outcome-reward training alone. We present RePro, Retrospective Progress-Aware Training, a framework that trains agents to self-generate progress signals via a forward-then-reflect rollout paradigm: the agent executes actions online, then retrospectively reassesses its step-wise progress given the completed trajectory and known outcome. RePro initializes with a Retrospection Warmup that teaches reflection format from minimal external demonstrations, then further trains through RePro-PO with a composite reward that produces self-generated signals without continuous external supervision. Experiments on WebShop, ALFWorld, and Sokoban show that RePro enhances the Qwen family's performance, with up to $12\%$ absolute success rate gains.
abstract_zh: 现有基于强化学习训练的 LLM Agent 通常优化逐步动作预测，但缺乏对任务进展的元认知感知，限制了其在长程任务中的扩展能力。论文通过先导实验发现，在线进展提示反而会损害性能，而基于完整轨迹的回顾式示范更有帮助；同时，仅依赖结果奖励训练难以自然涌现这种能力。为此，作者提出 RePro（Retrospective Progress-Aware Training），通过“先前向执行、再回顾反思”的 rollout 范式，让 Agent 在线执行动作后，基于已完成轨迹和已知结果重新评估每一步的任务进展。RePro 首先使用 Retrospection Warmup，通过少量外部示范学习反思格式；随后采用 RePro-PO，利用复合奖励训练模型在无持续外部监督下生成自我进展信号。在 WebShop、ALFWorld 和 Sokoban 上的实验表明，RePro 能提升 Qwen 系列模型表现，成功率最高带来 12% 的绝对增益。
key_points_zh: 指出长程 Agent 训练中的关键缺口：强化学习只优化动作预测，缺乏对任务进展的显式元认知建模。
发现在线 progress prompting 会干扰决策，而基于完整轨迹的 retrospective demonstrations 能更有效地提供进展监督。
提出 RePro 框架：Agent 先正常执行任务，再基于完整轨迹和最终结果回顾性评估每一步进展。
设计 Retrospection Warmup 与 RePro-PO：前者用少量示范学习反思格式，后者通过复合奖励实现自生成进展信号训练。
在 WebShop、ALFWorld、Sokoban 上验证 RePro 对 Qwen 系列模型有效，最高提升 12% 绝对成功率。

llm_assessment.comment: A relevant agent-training loop that uses completed trajectories to teach retrospective progress signals for long-horizon agents.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作利用完整轨迹训练智能体生成回顾性进度信号，对长程任务智能体训练具有相关价值。
